name: workflow_parameters
description:
Return the workflow-declared input parameters for a workflow before running it.

Use this before workflow_run to discover the keys, types, required/optional status, descriptions, and enum values that must be placed inside workflow_run.input. This only reports parameters declared by the workflow's parameters node; it does not include generic workflow_run options such as workdir, agentId, or wait.

If the workflow description says it operates on a project directory or uses bash/file-system nodes, pass the directory separately as workflow_run.workdir even though it is not returned by this tool.

workflowId.description: Workflow ID to inspect for declared input parameters, e.g. wf-product-intake-contract-v1; use workflow_list to see available IDs.
